name: hasCaptureSurface
meaning: nonzero selects the blocking transition mode

name: pos
meaning: screen x, y, z of the hole quad

name: alpha
meaning: alpha/scale term animated only in blocking mode

name: app
meaning: the renderer wrapper; +0x28 is the IDirect3DDevice7 and +0x41E40/+0x41E44 the two surfaces the wipe blits from

name: viewport
meaning: the Frustrum whose viewport it wipes (typed from its field reads - nearZ +0x08, viewportWidth +0x1c, viewportHeight +0x20 - and Frustrum_BuildProjectionMatrix 0x419b83 called on it at 0x5367eb)

name: useCubicBezier
meaning: selects the cubic Bezier path (0x538b2d, four control points with an extra point pulled toward the hole centre) instead of the quadratic one (0x5389d6) when building the ray vertices

name: radius
meaning: base radius of the hole ring; each ray direction is normalised and scaled by it before the Bezier sweep

name: rayDirs
meaning: the 8 outward directions of the radial fan, set by HoleFX_BuildMesh to the compass points of the viewport half-extent. Vec3f, not float[8][3]: HoleFX_Ctor runs a constructor loop over the 8 elements (proved by the match: without an element constructor the bytes differ)

name: vertexBuffer
meaning: IDirect3DVertexBuffer7 of 0x41 vertices, FVF 0xC4 (XYZRHW|DIFFUSE|SPECULAR, 0x18 bytes each). Lock is vtable slot 0xC, Unlock 0x10

name: tris
meaning: the 120 triangles of the wipe mesh, constructed in place by the ctor and destroyed backwards from +0xF8C

name: shadeScale
meaning: colour shading scale: read only by the fmul at 0x538d40 in the colour function 0x538d20; set by HoleFX_SetShading 0x53678f, 1.0 in HoleFX_Init. Never used for depth

name: shadeBias
meaning: colour shading bias: read only by the fadd at 0x538d49 in the colour function 0x538d20; set by HoleFX_SetShading 0x53678f, 0.0 in HoleFX_Init. Never used for depth

name: captureSurface
meaning: IDirectDrawSurface7 the wipe blits the frozen frame into; its existence is what selects blocking mode. GetSurfaceDesc is vtable slot 0x58, Blt is slot 0x14

name: captureWidth
meaning: dwWidth read back from the capture surface; divides each vertex x to give its U

name: captureHeight
meaning: dwHeight read back from the capture surface; divides each vertex y to give its V

name: captured
meaning: latch set the first time HoleFX_CaptureScreen runs; blocks any further capture unless the force argument is 1

name: maskTexture
meaning: 256x256 format-2 (ARGB4444) texture holding the circular alpha mask used by the non-blocking wipe; +0x04 is its pitch in pixels, +0x08 its height, +0x10 the D3D texture handle. Texture *: HoleFX_Destruct deletes it through its virtual scalar-deleting destructor (0x5364ba), HoleFX_Init builds it with Texture_Ctor 0x40a140

name: screenRadius
meaning: sqrt((vpW*vpW + vpH*vpH)/2) — the radius at which the non-blocking hole covers the whole screen
